correctness.rationale: Direct circle-arc geometry partitions the feasible fixed-total lengths into small, middle and large bands. In the interior, overlap equals u-d for imbalance t<=d and the shorter length u-t thereafter. Exact Bernoulli covariance has derivative 2t/T^2 on the first branch and -(T-2t)/T^2 on the second, giving a unique strict maximum t=d. Complement disjointness establishes sharp negativity outside the band. The full 0/1/2 richness law and exact rational sign inversion follow algebraically; 50000 geometry comparisons, 10000 optimizer checks, and fraction arithmetic independently support computations but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Directly motivated by long-term flowering-duration and coflowering-richness studies, the claim identifies a complete natural two-species one-time aggregation blindness: a continuum of flowering allocations gives exactly identical richness probabilities but different species cross-covariances, including opposite signs. It also gives a sharp feasibility band and strict optimal allocation, not an arbitrary narrow parameter instance. Species-resolved or time-indexed observations are explicitly outside the blind spot.
